# Tray trial A

## What it is

A wholly fictional lab record, `aster-tray-a-v1`; author identity and publication
date are recorded in the raw artifact header. This is not real experimental evidence.

## Claims

- A1 — Source claim: in one nominal 22 C trial, open reached the target in
  18 minutes and closed in 24 minutes. Evidence: `raw/trial-a.md`, Measurements.
- A2 — Author's view: recommend open for that nominal setup, with a single-trial
  limitation and no humidity measurement. Evidence: `raw/trial-a.md`, Recommendation.

## Why it matters here

Trial A's recommendation conflicts with [[wiki/sources/trial-b|Trial B]], claim B2
(raw Recommendation, observation 2026-09-08). Neither record establishes supersession.
